description: The Oostvaardersplassen visitor centre at Kitsweg is a long timber barn with a glass gable and a small lookout box pushed through that glass. The building is closed at this hour. Reed beds and dark water lie beyond it. It is partly cloudy, about 10.4°C, with wind near 2.2 km/h and cloud cover about 53%. This is not the black wood centre on the Almere side.
